newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt investigating fire on Israelis' coach.
newsitem.headline: Egypt investigating fire on Israelis' coach.

text.p: Egyptian investigators have asked forensic experts to find out why a coach carrying Israeli tourists caught fire on a flyover in Cairo earlier this week, security sources said on Wednesday.

No one was hurt in the incident, which took place on Monday night in central Cairo. Government newspapers said the driver had got out of the coach to find out why a tyre exploded and then noticed a spark in the engine, which set the coach ablaze.
The sources said forensic experts would examine the burn-out shell of the coach to determine the exact source of the fire.
The Israeli tourists, who had crossed into Egypt through the Sinai border post of Rafah, abandoned the burning coach and were taken to their hotel in another coach, the sources added.
